svg.title: Event-Driven Capture & Refund Flow - Standard Pattern (100% Reusable - Multi-Channel Architecture)

g.text: Event-Driven Capture & Refund Flow - Standard Pattern
Webhook doesn't touch DB or services!
Works for webhook, admin, API, MCP!
All 4 Trigger Channels Converge on Same Handlers:
MCP (AI agent) → MCP Tools → EventDispatcher → CaptureHandler/RefundHandler
Same business logic, validation, provider integration!
Entry Point → Emit Event → Handler executes →
- Same pattern: webhook + admin + API + MCP
